excerpt.zh: 我们发现了外形类似球体的高密度能量信号。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: We have discovered powerful concentrated energy in the form of an orb. Investigation is advised.

sections.en: We have discovered powerful concentrated energy in the form of an orb. Investigation is advised.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的异常能量读数的来源确定是一个蓝色的小球。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报，传感器从中发现了相反极性的快子。

该物体周围的地面上刻着符号，也许是由某个更古老的文明留下的。目前不清楚是符号的含义是指引还是警示。

完整的文本还远不能翻译，但部分符号似乎与时间测量和[Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中天体相对位置有关。
texts.en:
The source of the unusual energy readings noted on [From.GetName] is confirmed to be a small, blue orb. The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] report that sensors pick up tachyons of reverse polarity.

Symbols are carved into the ground around the object, perhaps placed there by an older civilization. It is unclear whether they are meant as an instruction, or a warning.

The full inscription is far from translated, but individual symbols seem related to the measuring of time and the relative positions of celestial objects in the [Solar_System.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
在[FromFrom.GetName]上的站点进行工作时，[Root.GetLeaderName]无意间擦到了蓝色球体。

[leader.GetHeSheCap]之后称看到了时间如同一条河流一般延展，前后连接着无尽的过去与未来。在[leader.GetHimHer]的面前，蓝色能量从时间流中蜿蜒涌出，被吸入了[leader.GetHisHer]的身体里。尽管该意外在[Owner.GetScientistPlural]精确测量中持续了不到一秒钟，但[leader.GetHeShe]感觉仿佛度过了一个多小时。

在幻觉结束后，[Root.GetLeaderName]确信时间不会再影响[leader.GetHimHer]了。[leader.GetHeShe]现在拥有了无限的时间，于是想利用无尽的寿命自行探索宇宙。
texts.en:
While working at the site on [FromFrom.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] brushed against the blue orb.

[leader.GetHeSheCap] later described a vision of time stretching out like a river into the infinite future and past. In front of [leader.GetHimHer], blue energy arced out of the timestream and was absorbed by [leader.GetHisHer] body. Although the incident was accurately measured by the other [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to span less than a second, [leader.GetHeShe] experienced it for more than a hour.

After the vision ended, [Root.GetLeaderName] was certain that time would no longer affect [leader.GetHimHer]. With an infinite lifetime ahead, [leader.GetHeShe] want[leader.GetSXX] to use [leader.GetHisHer] endless time to explore the universe on [leader.GetHisHer] own.

tooltips.zh: [intemporal_leader.GetName]得到一艘小型舰船以独自进行太空旅行。
tooltips.en: [intemporal_leader.GetName] receive[intemporal_leader.GetSXX] a small vessel to travel the stars alone.

tooltips.zh:
[intemporal_leader.GetName]得到一艘小型舰船以独自进行太空旅行。
需要指派一名新的科学官来指挥[From.GetName]。
tooltips.en:
[intemporal_leader.GetName] receive[intemporal_leader.GetSXX] a small vessel to travel the stars alone.
A new Scientist has to be assigned to lead [From.GetName].
[intemporal_leader.GetName] becomes available as a new Scientist.

texts.zh:
长程扫描发现了一艘舰船正在驶向[Root.Capital.GetName]。随着它越来越近，我们发现那艘船的设计与我们一世纪前的如出一辙。

在打开通讯之后，我们发现那艘舰船是[intemporal_explorer.GetName]驾驶的，就是那位被蓝色球体从时间流中带走的[Owner.GetScientist]。

[intemporal_explorer.GetHeSheCap]在对撞的中子星和逆转的时空引力井周围漫步，又乘坐飞船返回虚空。值得一提的是，我们的物理学家证实，他带回来的信息不仅大部分是可信的，而且甚至是开创性的。

[intemporal_explorer.GetName]的身体似乎完全不随着时间的流逝而改变，即便我们最近的科技也无法解释那颗球体的功能。[intemporal_explorer.GetHeShe]得以逃脱终极灭亡，将会继续探索宇宙，直到时间的终结。
texts.en:
Long-range scans picked up an approaching vessel near [Root.Capital.GetName]. As it moved closer, it became clear that the ship's design matched our own from a century ago.

After opening comms, we discovered that the ship was piloted by [intemporal_explorer.GetName], the [Owner.GetScientist] who [intemporal_explorer.GetWasWere] detached from the timestream by a blue energy orb.

[intemporal_explorer.GetHeSheCap] rambled about colliding neutron stars and inverse space-time gravitational wells, before taking the ship back into the dark. Remarkably, our physicists have confirmed that much of this information is not only verifiable, but indeed groundbreaking.

[intemporal_explorer.GetName] appeared physically unchanged by the passage of time, but even our current technology could not explain the functionality of the orb. Barring their own fatal destruction, [intemporal_explorer.GetHeShe] will continue to explore the universe until the end of time.

这位[Owner.GetScientist]的再次连入了我们，知识涌入集体思维中：那是关于对撞的中子星和逆转的时空引力井的观测记忆。传输一结束，这艘船又启程返回了虚空。值得一提的是，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]证实，他带回来的信息不仅大部分是可信的，而且甚至是开创性的。

[intemporal_explorer.GetName]的身体似乎完全不随着时间的流逝而改变，即便我们最近的科技也无法解释那颗球体的功能。[intemporal_explorer.GetHeShe]得以逃脱终极灭亡，将会继续探索宇宙，直到时间的终结。
texts.en:
Long-range scans picked up an approaching vessel near [Root.Capital.GetName]. As it moved closer, it became clear that the ship's design matched our own from a century ago. We discovered that the ship was piloted by [intemporal_explorer.GetName], the [Owner.GetScientist] who [intemporal_explorer.GetWasWere] detached from the timestream by a blue energy orb.

Again with us, knowledge flowed from the [Owner.GetScientist] into the collective: sense-impressions of colliding neutron stars and inverse space-time gravitational wells. Once the transfer was complete, the ship continued on into the dark. Remarkably, our physics [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have confirmed that much of this data is not only verifiable, but indeed groundbreaking.

[intemporal_explorer.GetName] appeared physically unchanged by the passage of time, but even our current technology could not explain the functionality of the orb. Barring their own fatal destruction, [intemporal_explorer.GetHeShe] will continue to explore the universe until the end of time.

texts.zh:
在[FromFrom.GetName]发现的蓝色能量球体消失了。对当地的扫描完全没有发现该球体的任何迹象。更令人困惑的是，地上的符号也一同消失得无影无踪，如同从未存在过一般。

基于在此处发现的异常的快子信号，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，球体和符号一同发生了时间回溯。
texts.en:
The orb of blue energy first detected on [FromFrom.GetName] has disappeared. A scan of the location show no traces of the strange sphere. Even more baffling is the erasure of the markings on the ground: it is as if they were never there.

Given the unusual tachyon readings we detected at the site, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] postulate that both the orb and the writing were moving backwards through time.
